messages:
Priya (AE): Quick heads-up: NimbusHealth procurement says they must buy via GCP Marketplace but also need the PO reflected on the vendor invoice (their G/L team will only accept vendor invoices). They asked for 20 seats, 12-month commit, 30% discount. Can we put Redwood on the invoice if it's a marketplace order? Need deal desk + legal.

Diego (SE): Marketplace private offers can set custom pricing, but Google invoices the customer for marketplace purchases. We can grant entitlements so their seats map correctly, but we won't be the billing party on the invoice.

Lena (Finance): Confirming Diego. GCP invoices directly for Marketplace purchases. If they insist Redwood on invoice, we need a direct contracting route (or work through a reseller partner that can issue invoices). 30% on $240k ARR (20 seats * $1k/mo * 12) is a heavy discount; margin will be tight after marketplace fees (~12%) and infra.

Priya (AE): They gave us a hard requirement: PO on vendor invoice + cost center code included. Procurement won't sign otherwise. They called out need for SOC2 attestation in contract too.

Omar (Legal): SOC2 addendum is fine for enterprise. Bigger question is billing entity. If they demand vendor invoice, we'd need a direct SOW/contract and invoice them monthly or upfront. That will add legal review (~5 business days). If they accept GCP invoice, faster but doesn't satisfy their AP process.

gcp-marketplace-bot: Private Offer created: OFFER-99231 — https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/privateOffers/OFFER-99231 (automated)

Ravi (Sales Ops): Laying out options for Nimbus to choose from:
1) GCP Private Offer (fastest): GCP invoices customer, custom pricing, entitlements map seats. Pros: quick POC, minimal legal. Cons: no Redwood invoice, can't include their PO/cost center on vendor invoice.
2) Direct Redwood Contract + Invoice (longer): We sign SOW + invoice directly as vendor, include PO and cost center. Pros: meets procurement. Cons: slower (legal + finance), requires direct billing setup.
3) Reseller path via partner (medium): partner invoices customer, partner reimburses us. Pros: may satisfy procurement. Cons: revenue share, partner setup time.

Priya (AE): Which path shortens time-to-PoC? They want to kick off POC ASAP (timeline: 1 week).

Diego (SE): Technically fastest is GCP private offer — we can spin up entitlements and a test environment in 3-5 days. Direct contract will add 1-2 weeks for legal + billing. Reseller depends on partner availability.

Lena (Finance): We can approve a one-off concession if margin is acceptable. Need a formal pricing calc. Quick back-of-envelope: list price seats = $1,000/mo * 20 = $20,000/mo -> $240k/yr. 30% discount = $72k discount. GCP fee (~12%) consumes ~ $28.8k of revenue, leaving lower net. We need Deal Desk approval for >25% discounts on enterprise commits.

Omar (Legal): I'll prepare a short SOC2 addendum draft if we go direct. Also flagging compliance: PII handling clause may be needed for health vertical.

Priya (AE): Action items: (1) Ravi open Deal Desk (please include cost center and PO requirement), (2) Lena produce quick margin calc and indicate if >25% is escalatable, (3) Diego prepare minimal POC manifest for GCP private offer path, (4) Omar draft SOC2 addendum if direct route. I'll present both options to the customer.

Ravi (Sales Ops): Deal opened: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/DEAL-2350. I attached the procurement note from Nimbus (they pasted their PO template) and flagged legal/finance. Priority=urgent.

gcp-marketplace-bot: Private Offer status: OFFER-99231 -> PENDING_ACCEPTANCE (automated)

Lena (Finance): If they insist on direct invoice + 30% we need a counterproposal: either 20% plus 6-month prepay or 25% with NET45 invoicing. That reduces risk. If they accept GCP invoice, we can offer 30% on the private offer subject to entitlement verification.

Diego (SE): POC config for GCP Private Offer (draft):
```
project: redwood-nimbus-poc
cluster: n1-standard-8
node_count: 4
model: r-infer-medium
entitlements: nimbus-20-seats
quota: 100k-tokens/day
cache: prefix-kv
```
Will prepare infra estimate and expected cost delta for finance.

Priya (AE): Nimbus procurement replied: they are open to a reseller if Redwood can propose a named partner who can invoice them within 48 hours. Do we have approved reseller partners?

Ravi (Sales Ops): We have two partners we can contact: CloudResell LLC and Meridian Cloud Partners. I'll ping both and see who can onboard quickly.

Omar (Legal): If reseller used, contract needs assignment and revenue share terms. That will take some review but could be quicker than full direct billing setup.

Priya (AE): Okay — I'll present three options to Nimbus and ask them to prioritize. Thanks team :thumbsup:. Keep threads here; update DEAL-2350 with any procurement responses.

Lena (Finance): I'll post a short spreadsheet in the deal ticket with margin scenarios. ETA 24 hours.

Diego (SE): ETA for POC infra estimate: 48 hours.

Ravi (Sales Ops): Reached out to partners; CloudResell responded they can onboard in 72 hours. Meridian needs legal intake.

Priya (AE): Great — closing for now. I'll update Nimbus and mark prospective go/no-go based on which invoicing path they select.
